title: Moderate augmentation transforms
description: Extend src/utils.py get_transforms with 'moderate' train preset: horizontal flip, rotation <=10deg, mild brightness/contrast jitter. Eval/test transforms unchanged (no aug). Wire --aug {off,moderate} flag into src/train_classifier.py, default off reproduces current behavior. Moderate only — no aggressive crop/color transforms that hide cracks. Label 0 = Damaged untouched.
acceptance_criteria: get_transforms('train', aug='moderate') applies flip + rotation<=10deg + mild jitter
Eval/test transforms identical to pre-change (no augmentation)
Default aug='off' reproduces current flip-only training behavior
